title: Independence of irrelevant alternatives
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, and let a ranking profile assign one of the six strict rankings of three candidates to each of $n$ voters. A rule $F$ assigns a sign in $bbZ^$ to each profile and each of the three candidate pairs. The rule satisfies independence of irrelevant alternatives if, for every candidate pair and every two profiles with the same pairwise votes for that pair, the rule returns the same sign for that pair.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ maps each ranking profile and candidate pair to a sign
For every candidate pair, profiles with equal pairwise votes receive equal output signs
